# Authentication

* API Key (BotToken)
    - Parameter Name: **Authorization**, in: header. Discord bot token

- oAuth2 authentication.

    - Flow: implicit
    - Authorization URL = [https://discord.com/api/oauth2/authorize](https://discord.com/api/oauth2/authorize)
    - Refresh URL = [https://discord.com/api/oauth2/token](https://discord.com/api/oauth2/token)

|Scope|Scope Description|
|---|---|
|activities.invites.write|allows your app to send activity invites - requires Discord approval (NOT REQUIRED FOR GAMESDK ACTIVITY MANAGER)|
|activities.read|allows your app to fetch data from a user's "Now Playing/Recently Played" list - requires Discord approval|
|activities.write|allows your app to update a user's activity - requires Discord approval (NOT REQUIRED FOR GAMESDK ACTIVITY MANAGER)|
|applications.builds.read|allows your app to read build data for a user's applications|
|applications.builds.upload|allows your app to upload/update builds for a user's applications - requires Discord approval|
|applications.commands|allows your app to use commands in a guild|
|applications.commands.permissions.update|allows your app to update permissions for its commands in a guild a user has permissions to|
|applications.entitlements|allows your app to read entitlements for a user's applications|
|applications.store.update|allows your app to read and update store data (SKUs, store listings, achievements, etc.) for a user's applications|
|bot|for oauth2 bots, this puts the bot in the user's selected guild by default|
|connections|allows /users/@me/connections to return linked third-party accounts|
|dm_channels.read|allows your app to see information about the user's DMs and group DMs - requires Discord approval|
|email|enables /users/@me to return an email|
|gdm.join|allows your app to join users to a group dm|
|guilds|allows /users/@me/guilds to return basic information about all of a user's guilds|
|guilds.join|allows /guilds/{guild.id}/members/{user.id} to be used for joining users to a guild|
|guilds.members.read|allows /users/@me/guilds/{guild.id}/member to return a user's member information in a guild|
|identify|allows /users/@me without email|
|messages.read|for local rpc server api access, this allows you to read messages from all client channels (otherwise restricted to channels/guilds your app creates)|
|openid|for OpenID Connect, this allows your app to receive user id and basic profile information|
|relationships.read|allows your app to know a user's friends and implicit relationships - requires Discord approval|
|rpc|for local rpc server access, this allows you to control a user's local Discord client - requires Discord approval|
|rpc.activities.write|for local rpc server access, this allows you to update a user's activity - requires Discord approval|
|rpc.notifications.read|for local rpc server access, this allows you to receive notifications pushed out to the user - requires Discord approval|
|rpc.screenshare.read|for local rpc server access, this allows you to read a user's screenshare status- requires Discord approval|
|rpc.screenshare.write|for local rpc server access, this allows you to update a user's screenshare settings- requires Discord approval|
|rpc.video.read|for local rpc server access, this allows you to read a user's video status - requires Discord approval|
|rpc.video.write|for local rpc server access, this allows you to update a user's video settings - requires Discord approval|
|rpc.voice.read|for local rpc server access, this allows you to read a user's voice settings and listen for voice events - requires Discord approval|
|rpc.voice.write|for local rpc server access, this allows you to update a user's voice settings - requires Discord approval|
|voice|allows your app to connect to voice on user's behalf and see all the voice members - requires Discord approval|
|webhook.incoming|this generates a webhook that is returned in the oauth token response for authorization code grants|

    - Flow: clientCredentials
    - Token URL = [https://discord.com/api/oauth2/token](https://discord.com/api/oauth2/token)
    - Refresh URL = [https://discord.com/api/oauth2/token](https://discord.com/api/oauth2/token)

|Scope|Scope Description|

## get_my_application

<a id="opIdget_my_application"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://discord.com/api/v10/applications/@me \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

<h3 id="getmyapplication-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|200 response for get_my_application|[PrivateApplicationResponse](#schemaprivateapplicationresponse)|
|429|Too Many Requests|Client ratelimited response|[RatelimitedResponse](#schemaratelimitedresponse)|
|4XX|Client Error|Client error response|[ErrorResponse](#schemaerrorresponse)|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|X-RateLimit-Limit|integer||The maximum number of requests that can be made in the current ratelimit window|
|200|X-RateLimit-Remaining|integer||The number of requests remaining in the current ratelimit window|
|200|X-RateLimit-Reset|number||A unix timestamp in seconds at which the current ratelimit window resets|
|200|X-RateLimit-Reset-After|number||The duration in seconds until the current ratelimit window resets|
|200|X-RateLimit-Bucket|string||The bucket that the request belongs to|
|429|X-RateLimit-Limit|integer||The maximum number of requests that can be made in the current ratelimit window|
|429|X-RateLimit-Remaining|integer||The number of requests remaining in the current ratelimit window|
|429|X-RateLimit-Reset|number||A unix timestamp in seconds at which the current ratelimit window resets|
|429|X-RateLimit-Reset-After|number||The duration in seconds until the current ratelimit window resets|
|429|X-RateLimit-Bucket|string||The bucket that the request belongs to|
|4XX|X-RateLimit-Limit|integer||The maximum number of requests that can be made in the current ratelimit window|
|4XX|X-RateLimit-Remaining|integer||The number of requests remaining in the current ratelimit window|
|4XX|X-RateLimit-Reset|number||A unix timestamp in seconds at which the current ratelimit window resets|
|4XX|X-RateLimit-Reset-After|number||The duration in seconds until the current ratelimit window resets|
|4XX|X-RateLimit-Bucket|string||The bucket that the request belongs to|

## update_my_application

<a id="opIdupdate_my_application"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://discord.com/api/v10/applications/@me \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "description": {
      "default": "string",
      "localizations": {
        "property1": "string",
        "property2": "string"
      }
    },
    "icon": "string",
    "cover_image": "string",
    "team_id": "string",
    "flags": 0,
    "interactions_endpoint_url": "http://example.com",
    "explicit_content_filter": 0,
    "max_participants": -1,
    "type": 4,
    "tags": [
      "string"
    ],
    "custom_install_url": "http://example.com",
    "install_params": {
      "scopes": [
        "applications.commands"
      ],
      "permissions": 0
    },
    "role_connections_verification_url": "http://example.com",
    "integration_types_config": {
      "property1": {
        "oauth2_install_params": {
          "scopes": [
            "applications.commands"
          ],
          "permissions": 0
        }
      },
      "property2": {
        "oauth2_install_params": {
          "scopes": [
            "applications.commands"
          ],
          "permissions": 0
        }
      }
    },
    "event_webhooks_status": 1,
    "event_webhooks_url": "http://example.com",
    "event_webhooks_types": [
      "APPLICATION_AUTHORIZED"
    ]
  }'
```

`PATCH /applications/@me`

> Body parameter


|200|X-RateLimit-Reset-After|number||The duration in seconds until the current ratelimit window resets|
|200|X-RateLimit-Bucket|string||The bucket that the request belongs to|

<h3 id="getmessage-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|200 response for get_message|[MessageResponse](#schemamessageresponse)|
|429|Too Many Requests|Client ratelimited response|[RatelimitedResponse](#schemaratelimitedresponse)|
|4XX|Client Error|Client error response|[ErrorResponse](#schemaerrorresponse)|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|X-RateLimit-Limit|integer||The maximum number of requests that can be made in the current ratelimit window|
|200|X-RateLimit-Remaining|integer||The number of requests remaining in the current ratelimit window|
|200|X-RateLimit-Reset|number||A unix timestamp in seconds at which the current ratelimit window resets|
|200|X-RateLimit-Reset-After|number||The duration in seconds until the current ratelimit window resets|
|200|X-RateLimit-Bucket|string||The bucket that the request belongs to|
|429|X-RateLimit-Limit|integer||The maximum number of requests that can be made in the current ratelimit window|
|429|X-RateLimit-Remaining|integer||The number of requests remaining in the current ratelimit window|
|429|X-RateLimit-Reset|number||A unix timestamp in seconds at which the current ratelimit window resets|
|429|X-RateLimit-Reset-After|number||The duration in seconds until the current ratelimit window resets|
|429|X-RateLimit-Bucket|string||The bucket that the request belongs to|
|4XX|X-RateLimit-Limit|integer||The maximum number of requests that can be made in the current ratelimit window|
|4XX|X-RateLimit-Remaining|integer||The number of requests remaining in the current ratelimit window|
|4XX|X-RateLimit-Reset|number||A unix timestamp in seconds at which the current ratelimit window resets|
|4XX|X-RateLimit-Reset-After|number||The duration in seconds until the current ratelimit window resets|
|4XX|X-RateLimit-Bucket|string||The bucket that the request belongs to|

To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
BotToken

## delete_message

<a id="opIddelete_message"></a>

```bash
curl https://discord.com/api/v10/channels/string/messages/string \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

<h3 id="updatemessage-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|200 response for update_message|[MessageResponse](#schemamessageresponse)|
|429|Too Many Requests|Client ratelimited response|[RatelimitedResponse](#schemaratelimitedresponse)|
|4XX|Client Error|Client error response|[ErrorResponse](#schemaerrorresponse)|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|X-RateLimit-Limit|integer||The maximum number of requests that can be made in the current ratelimit window|
|200|X-RateLimit-Remaining|integer||The number of requests remaining in the current ratelimit window|
|200|X-RateLimit-Reset|number||A unix timestamp in seconds at which the current ratelimit window resets|
|200|X-RateLimit-Reset-After|number||The duration in seconds until the current ratelimit window resets|
|200|X-RateLimit-Bucket|string||The bucket that the request belongs to|
|429|X-RateLimit-Limit|integer||The maximum number of requests that can be made in the current ratelimit window|
|429|X-RateLimit-Remaining|integer||The number of requests remaining in the current ratelimit window|
|429|X-RateLimit-Reset|number||A unix timestamp in seconds at which the current ratelimit window resets|
|429|X-RateLimit-Reset-After|number||The duration in seconds until the current ratelimit window resets|
|429|X-RateLimit-Bucket|string||The bucket that the request belongs to|
|4XX|X-RateLimit-Limit|integer||The maximum number of requests that can be made in the current ratelimit window|
|4XX|X-RateLimit-Remaining|integer||The number of requests remaining in the current ratelimit window|
|4XX|X-RateLimit-Reset|number||A unix timestamp in seconds at which the current ratelimit window resets|
|4XX|X-RateLimit-Reset-After|number||The duration in seconds until the current ratelimit window resets|
|4XX|X-RateLimit-Bucket|string||The bucket that the request belongs to|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
BotToken
</aside>

## crosspost_message

<a id="opIdcrosspost_message"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://discord.com/api/v10/channels/string/messages/string/crosspost \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`POST /channels/{channel_id}/messages/{message_id}/crosspost`

<h3 id="crosspostmessage-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|channel_id|path|[SnowflakeType](#schemasnowflaketype)|true|none|
|message_id|path|[SnowflakeType](#schemasnowflaketype)|true|none|

|429|Too Many Requests|Client ratelimited response|[RatelimitedResponse](#schemaratelimitedresponse)|
|4XX|Client Error|Client error response|[ErrorResponse](#schemaerrorresponse)|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|204|X-RateLimit-Limit|integer||The maximum number of requests that can be made in the current ratelimit window|
|204|X-RateLimit-Remaining|integer||The number of requests remaining in the current ratelimit window|
|204|X-RateLimit-Reset|number||A unix timestamp in seconds at which the current ratelimit window resets|
|204|X-RateLimit-Reset-After|number||The duration in seconds until the current ratelimit window resets|
|204|X-RateLimit-Bucket|string||The bucket that the request belongs to|
|429|X-RateLimit-Limit|integer||The maximum number of requests that can be made in the current ratelimit window|
|429|X-RateLimit-Remaining|integer||The number of requests remaining in the current ratelimit window|
|429|X-RateLimit-Reset|number||A unix timestamp in seconds at which the current ratelimit window resets|
|429|X-RateLimit-Reset-After|number||The duration in seconds until the current ratelimit window resets|
|429|X-RateLimit-Bucket|string||The bucket that the request belongs to|
|4XX|X-RateLimit-Limit|integer||The maximum number of requests that can be made in the current ratelimit window|
|4XX|X-RateLimit-Remaining|integer||The number of requests remaining in the current ratelimit window|
|4XX|X-RateLimit-Reset|number||A unix timestamp in seconds at which the current ratelimit window resets|
|4XX|X-RateLimit-Reset-After|number||The duration in seconds until the current ratelimit window resets|
|4XX|X-RateLimit-Bucket|string||The bucket that the request belongs to|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
BotToken
</aside>

## deprecated_list_pins

<a id="opIddeprecated_list_pins"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://discord.com/api/v10/channels/string/pins \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /channels/{channel_id}/pins`

<h3 id="deprecatedlistpins-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|channel_id|path|[SnowflakeType](#schemasnowflaketype)|true|none|

|200|X-RateLimit-Bucket|string||The bucket that the request belongs to|

<h3 id="listprivatearchivedthreads-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|200 response for list_private_archived_threads|[ThreadsResponse](#schemathreadsresponse)|
|429|Too Many Requests|Client ratelimited response|[RatelimitedResponse](#schemaratelimitedresponse)|
|4XX|Client Error|Client error response|[ErrorResponse](#schemaerrorresponse)|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|X-RateLimit-Limit|integer||The maximum number of requests that can be made in the current ratelimit window|
|200|X-RateLimit-Remaining|integer||The number of requests remaining in the current ratelimit window|
|200|X-RateLimit-Reset|number||A unix timestamp in seconds at which the current ratelimit window resets|
|200|X-RateLimit-Reset-After|number||The duration in seconds until the current ratelimit window resets|
|200|X-RateLimit-Bucket|string||The bucket that the request belongs to|
|429|X-RateLimit-Limit|integer||The maximum number of requests that can be made in the current ratelimit window|
|429|X-RateLimit-Remaining|integer||The number of requests remaining in the current ratelimit window|
|429|X-RateLimit-Reset|number||A unix timestamp in seconds at which the current ratelimit window resets|
|429|X-RateLimit-Reset-After|number||The duration in seconds until the current ratelimit window resets|
|429|X-RateLimit-Bucket|string||The bucket that the request belongs to|
|4XX|X-RateLimit-Limit|integer||The maximum number of requests that can be made in the current ratelimit window|
|4XX|X-RateLimit-Remaining|integer||The number of requests remaining in the current ratelimit window|
|4XX|X-RateLimit-Reset|number||A unix timestamp in seconds at which the current ratelimit window resets|
|4XX|X-RateLimit-Reset-After|number||The duration in seconds until the current ratelimit window resets|
|4XX|X-RateLimit-Bucket|string||The bucket that the request belongs to|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
BotToken
</aside>

## list_public_archived_threads

<a id="opIdlist_public_archived_threads"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://discord.com/api/v10/channels/string/threads/archived/public \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /channels/{channel_id}/threads/archived/public`

<h3 id="listpublicarchivedthreads-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|before|query|string(date-time)|false|none|
|limit|query|integer|false|none|
|channel_id|path|[SnowflakeType](#schemasnowflaketype)|true|none|

<h3 id="listpublicarchivedthreads-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|200 response for list_public_archived_threads|[ThreadsResponse](#schemathreadsresponse)|
|429|Too Many Requests|Client ratelimited response|[RatelimitedResponse](#schemaratelimitedresponse)|
|4XX|Client Error|Client error response|[ErrorResponse](#schemaerrorresponse)|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|X-RateLimit-Limit|integer||The maximum number of requests that can be made in the current ratelimit window|
|200|X-RateLimit-Remaining|integer||The number of requests remaining in the current ratelimit window|
|200|X-RateLimit-Reset|number||A unix timestamp in seconds at which the current ratelimit window resets|
|200|X-RateLimit-Reset-After|number||The duration in seconds until the current ratelimit window resets|
|200|X-RateLimit-Bucket|string||The bucket that the request belongs to|
|429|X-RateLimit-Limit|integer||The maximum number of requests that can be made in the current ratelimit window|
|429|X-RateLimit-Remaining|integer||The number of requests remaining in the current ratelimit window|
|429|X-RateLimit-Reset|number||A unix timestamp in seconds at which the current ratelimit window resets|
|429|X-RateLimit-Reset-After|number||The duration in seconds until the current ratelimit window resets|
|429|X-RateLimit-Bucket|string||The bucket that the request belongs to|
|4XX|X-RateLimit-Limit|integer||The maximum number of requests that can be made in the current ratelimit window|
|4XX|X-RateLimit-Remaining|integer||The number of requests remaining in the current ratelimit window|
|4XX|X-RateLimit-Reset|number||A unix timestamp in seconds at which the current ratelimit window resets|
|4XX|X-RateLimit-Reset-After|number||The duration in seconds until the current ratelimit window resets|
|4XX|X-RateLimit-Bucket|string||The bucket that the request belongs to|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
BotToken
</aside>

## thread_search

<a id="opIdthread_search"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://discord.com/api/v10/channels/string/threads/search \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /channels/{channel_id}/threads/search`

<h3 id="threadsearch-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|name|query|string|false|none|
|slop|query|integer|false|none|
|min_id|query|[SnowflakeType](#schemasnowflaketype)|false|none|
|max_id|query|[SnowflakeType](#schemasnowflaketype)|false|none|
|tag|query|string \| [[SnowflakeType](#schemasnowflaketype)]|false|none|
|tag_setting|query|[ThreadSearchTagSetting](#schemathreadsearchtagsetting)|false|none|
|archived|query|boolean|false|none|
|sort_by|query|[ThreadSortingMode](#schemathreadsortingmode)|false|none|
|sort_order|query|[SortingOrder](#schemasortingorder)|false|none|
|limit|query|integer|false|none|
|offset|query|integer|false|none|
|channel_id|path|[SnowflakeType](#schemasnowflaketype)|true|none|

<h3 id="threadsearch-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|200 response for thread_search|[ThreadSearchResponse](#schemathreadsearchresponse)|
|202|Accepted|202 response for thread_search|[SearchIndexNotReadyResponse](#schemasearchindexnotreadyresponse)|
|429|Too Many Requests|Client ratelimited response|[RatelimitedResponse](#schemaratelimitedresponse)|
|4XX|Client Error|Client error response|[ErrorResponse](#schemaerrorresponse)|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|X-RateLimit-Limit|integer||The maximum number of requests that can be made in the current ratelimit window|
|200|X-RateLimit-Remaining|integer||The number of requests remaining in the current ratelimit window|
|200|X-RateLimit-Reset|number||A unix timestamp in seconds at which the current ratelimit window resets|
|200|X-RateLimit-Reset-After|number||The duration in seconds until the current ratelimit window resets|
|200|X-RateLimit-Bucket|string||The bucket that the request belongs to|
|202|X-RateLimit-Limit|integer||The maximum number of requests that can be made in the current ratelimit window|
|202|X-RateLimit-Remaining|integer||The number of requests remaining in the current ratelimit window|
|202|X-RateLimit-Reset|number||A unix timestamp in seconds at which the current ratelimit window resets|
|202|X-RateLimit-Reset-After|number||The duration in seconds until the current ratelimit window resets|
|202|X-RateLimit-Bucket|string||The bucket that the request belongs to|
|429|X-RateLimit-Limit|integer||The maximum number of requests that can be made in the current ratelimit window|
|429|X-RateLimit-Remaining|integer||The number of requests remaining in the current ratelimit window|
|429|X-RateLimit-Reset|number||A unix timestamp in seconds at which the current ratelimit window resets|
|429|X-RateLimit-Reset-After|number||The duration in seconds until the current ratelimit window resets|
|429|X-RateLimit-Bucket|string||The bucket that the request belongs to|

|200|X-RateLimit-Reset|number||A unix timestamp in seconds at which the current ratelimit window resets|
|200|X-RateLimit-Reset-After|number||The duration in seconds until the current ratelimit window resets|
|200|X-RateLimit-Bucket|string||The bucket that the request belongs to|

<h3 id="executewebhook-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|200 response for execute_webhook|[MessageResponse](#schemamessageresponse)|
|204|No Content|204 response for execute_webhook|None|
|429|Too Many Requests|Client ratelimited response|[RatelimitedResponse](#schemaratelimitedresponse)|
|4XX|Client Error|Client error response|[ErrorResponse](#schemaerrorresponse)|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|X-RateLimit-Limit|integer||The maximum number of requests that can be made in the current ratelimit window|
|200|X-RateLimit-Remaining|integer||The number of requests remaining in the current ratelimit window|
|200|X-RateLimit-Reset|number||A unix timestamp in seconds at which the current ratelimit window resets|
|200|X-RateLimit-Reset-After|number||The duration in seconds until the current ratelimit window resets|
|200|X-RateLimit-Bucket|string||The bucket that the request belongs to|
|204|X-RateLimit-Limit|integer||The maximum number of requests that can be made in the current ratelimit window|
|204|X-RateLimit-Remaining|integer||The number of requests remaining in the current ratelimit window|
|204|X-RateLimit-Reset|number||A unix timestamp in seconds at which the current ratelimit window resets|
|204|X-RateLimit-Reset-After|number||The duration in seconds until the current ratelimit window resets|
|204|X-RateLimit-Bucket|string||The bucket that the request belongs to|
|429|X-RateLimit-Limit|integer||The maximum number of requests that can be made in the current ratelimit window|
|429|X-RateLimit-Remaining|integer||The number of requests remaining in the current ratelimit window|
|429|X-RateLimit-Reset|number||A unix timestamp in seconds at which the current ratelimit window resets|
|429|X-RateLimit-Reset-After|number||The duration in seconds until the current ratelimit window resets|
|429|X-RateLimit-Bucket|string||The bucket that the request belongs to|
|4XX|X-RateLimit-Limit|integer||The maximum number of requests that can be made in the current ratelimit window|
|4XX|X-RateLimit-Remaining|integer||The number of requests remaining in the current ratelimit window|
|4XX|X-RateLimit-Reset|number||A unix timestamp in seconds at which the current ratelimit window resets|

## get_webhook_message

<a id="opIdget_webhook_message"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://discord.com/api/v10/webhooks/string/string/messages/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /webhooks/{webhook_id}/{webhook_token}/messages/{message_id}`

<h3 id="getwebhookmessage-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|thread_id|query|[SnowflakeType](#schemasnowflaketype)|false|none|
|webhook_id|path|[SnowflakeType](#schemasnowflaketype)|true|none|
|webhook_token|path|string|true|none|
|message_id|path|[SnowflakeType](#schemasnowflaketype)|true|none|

## execute_slack_compatible_webhook

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://discord.com/api/v10/webhooks/string/string/slack \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "text": "string",
    "username": "string",
    "icon_url": "http://example.com",
    "attachments": [
      {
        "title": "string",
        "title_link": "http://example.com",
        "text": "string",
        "color": "string",
        "ts": 0,
        "pretext": "string",
        "footer": "string",
        "footer_icon": "http://example.com",

        "author_link": "http://example.com",
        "author_icon": "http://example.com",
        "image_url": "http://example.com",
        "thumb_url": "http://example.com",
        "fields": [
          {
            "name": "string",
            "value": "string",
            "inline": true
          }
        ]
      }
    ]
  }'
```
